messages:
sarah: Anyone else hitting ESM/CJS import issues using the JS SDK in a Next.js app-router with edge runtime? Our sample app fails on deploy with "Error: require is not defined".

mike: yep saw that. Happens when package is published as CJS or when Next tries to bundle server-only code into edge. What does the stack show?

sarah: stack points to node_modules/redwood-sdk/index.cjs -> uses require('fs') inside initAuth. Edge runtime doesn't allow fs/require. Repro in production edge (Vercel).

olga: is the SDK shipping dual ESM/CJS builds with proper 'exports' field? Next's edge needs ESM entrypoint and tree-shakeable code.

sarah: package.json has "main": "dist/index.cjs", "module": "dist/index.esm.js" but no exports map. Next sometimes picks cjs.

mike: missing exports mapping is prob the root. Can add conditional exports: {"import": "dist/index.esm.js","require":"dist/index.cjs"}. Also need to move server-only modules behind dynamic import or a runtime check.

james: typings question — TS consumers in app-router were getting 'Cannot find type definition for package' when importing from 'redwood-sdk/server'. Any clues?

sarah: current hack is import('redwood-sdk').then(m => m.initAuth(...)) inside route handler and only call on server. But it's messy.

devex-bot: Heads-up: created sample-app PR template for nextjs-edge-fixes, see https://git.redwood/samples/nextjs-edge-fixes (internal).

olga: workaround: mark package as "type":"module" and export conditional map; publish a separate entrypoint @redwood/sdk/edge that excludes fs and crypto calls. Could also provide top-level exported async factory that lazy-loads node deps only on node runtimes.

mike: I'll open a PR to add exports + an 'edge' entrypoint. For now suggest people: 1) avoid server-only imports in client/server boundary; 2) use dynamic import within server functions; 3) in next.config.js set experimental: {esmExternals:true}.

sarah: confirmed experimental flag fixes dev build but not Vercel edge deployment. We should document recommended setup and include runtime-safe edge build.

james: typings: we can add "types": "dist/index.d.ts" and ensure declarations for the ESM and CJS entrypoints point to same d.ts. I'll draft.

olga: can we add a small note in onboarding docs and a sample server-only vs edge-safe import snippet?

sarah: yes. I'll open doc ticket + link sample. @mike please reference PR number.

mike: PR opened: #2118 — adds exports map + edge entrypoint + README note. Tagging eng-runtime for review.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-1245 (onboarding doc + sample).

sarah: thanks. For others hitting this: immediate workaround is copy the SDK server init into a server module that never runs on edge, or switch route to serverless node (not edge).
